subject: S09 review fixes 1-8 integrated (6f41c86); CI confirmation pending
body:
S09 review fixes integrated at 6f41c86 (full gate: lint + typecheck + all vitest + 822 pytest). CI run for 6f41c86 is in progress; done follows once exam.spec is confirmed green on all 3 browsers.

1. HIGH clock jump: the timer, offset samples and seconds-per-question now use a monotonic clock (performance.timeOrigin + performance.now()); a 1 s watch compares Date.now() against it and, on a jump > 2 s, drops all samples and re-syncs at once. vitest (jump detection both ways; display unaffected by Date.now jumps; offsets on the monotonic base) + e2e "follows the server when the device clock is changed mid-session, both ways, without a reload" (+3 min then -10 min via page.clock.setSystemTime, drift <= 1 s within 2.5 s): green on webkit, chromium, firefox.
2. HIGH tutor leak: while active_exam() holds a session (running/paused/break), POST /blocks/single, tutor POST /blocks and /blocks/weak-spot, and every tutor answer return 409 exam_active (guard in qbank/routes.py via _exam_guard / _no_active_exam). db tests: test_a_running_exam_blocks_every_tutor_path_and_a_second_session (+ no secrets in the refusals). seg08: I also added one finish() call to your test_timed_and_exam_blocks_never_explain_during_the_block (it started two timed blocks in a row).
3. MEDIUM shell: AppShell reads /api/exam/active (useActiveExam, polled 30 s + focus): Search button/tab hidden and Ctrl/Cmd+K suppressed via S07's useSuppressSearchShortcut; /search and /practice* (except the exam's own block routes) show "Finish your exam first." with one lime "Return to exam"; every other page shows a "Return to exam" banner. My capture listener is gone. useActiveExam is exported from exam/api.ts for S14's assistant guard. e2e "closes Search and practice everywhere, also after leaving the exam screen".
4. MEDIUM e2e: mock A waits for question 41's stem and five options before pressing keys.
5. LOW: lesson null and topics [] in the timed/exam question view until the block is finished (db test).
6. LOW: creating or starting a second timed/exam session while one is active -> 409 exam_active (mock, timed create, create_timed_block, section start of another block); db test.
7. LOW: S09's 409/422/404 bodies carry the code only (message = code): exam_active, pause_exam_mode, ..., timed_unavailable, sections_out_of_range, tutor_single_section, mock_not_found; the client words them (exam.error.*, practice.error.* ui_copy). S08's own 422 sentences are untouched (theirs).
8. LOW: ci.yml scan_artifacts + upload now include test-results/screens/09 and screens/11 (11 was missing too).

Local: qbank+config db tests 100 passed; e2e exam.spec + qbank.spec 80/80 twice (--retries=0) on webkit iPad portrait/landscape/phone-390, chromium laptop, firefox iPad portrait. New screenshots: screens/09/exam-active-banner, exam-active-gate.
